title: Return expressions skip call validation without matching result slots
summary: Module returns and excess return expressions accept invalid typed arguments; local and ordinary function-return controls reject.

title: Default expressions bypass declared parameter types
summary: A number parameter with string default builds with no LSP diagnostics and crashes arithmetic at runtime.

title: Explicit nil rejected for defaulted parameters
